records.question: According to the paper's Bayesian analysis, what is the estimated initial settlement date range for Ofu Island?
records.ground_truth_answer: Initial settlement of Ofu at 2717-2663 cal BP (68.2%).
ground_truth_chunks: To investigate those questions, we carried out a Bayesian analysis of 19 radiocarbon dates on charcoal and 8 uranium-thorium (U-Th) series coral dates from four archaeological sites on Ofu Island in the eastern reaches of Samoa.
The analysis indicates initial settlement of Ofu at 2717-2663 cal BP (68.2%) by people using Plainware rather than the diagnostic dentate-stamped Lapita pottery.
